specs.title: installation guide is accessible, unforced and uses the existing brand
a browser install prompt is invoked only after the customer asks
standalone-mode navigation has a safe Back fallback and phone-safe layout
offline cold launch exposes only labelled historical saves, not live shopping actions
offline private deep links never redirect to login or reveal cached customer pages
offline shell is safe even when navigator.onLine incorrectly reports online
connection loss preserves entered fields, locks sensitive actions and never auto-submits on reconnection
API reads and mutations remain network-only with no offline replay queue
online-only mode preserves saved lists, private link storage, cookies and unrelated caches
a waiting update does not reload another tab or erase its form
the classic tombstone removes only PWA caches and registration without forcing reload
unsupported installation still leaves a fully usable website and honest guide
blocked browser storage does not crash the install guide or saved board
real classic package switches back to the website and can resume the PWA without losing saves
corrupt saved records cannot break an offline cold start
evicted offline files produce an honest branded recovery page instead of a blank screen
hospitality cold-offline routes keep navigation but do not claim live inventory
